      Main render loop coordinating terrain, grid shapes, buildings, and sidebar UI.
      Parameters:
      shapeRenderer - geometry renderer for non-textured shapes
      batch - sprite renderer for textured content
      grid - grid model
      window - window layout context
      buildingTextures - texture map keyed by building type
      grassTex - grass texture used for terrain
      pendingBuilding - building selected for grid placement
